hero_tagline: Vietnam's Leading Mental Health Connection Platform
mission_statement: Connecting people seeking psychological support with verified experts — fast, safe, and transparent.
vision_statement: To become the leading neutral platform that helps everyone easily access the most suitable expertise.
our_story_content: We noticed many people want to access mental health professionals but face barriers: not knowing where to find them, concerns about quality, or difficulty comparing costs. PsyConnect was created as a trusted bridge — where clients can search, compare, and book appointments with high-quality independent counseling experts, based on detailed profiles, real user reviews, and our rigorous verification process.
verification_description: We apply a rigorous 4-step verification process to ensure the quality of experts on our platform.
verification_steps: Verification of practical experience & professional references
Commitment to professional ethics & legal compliance
featured_experts_desc: Top mental health professionals who have been verified and have extensive experience on our platform.
services_description: We provide various types of psychological counseling services to meet diverse client needs.
individual_counseling_desc: Private counseling sessions with suitable experts, available online or at clinics.
group_therapy_desc: Topic-specific support groups led by experienced professionals.
couples_therapy_desc: Support for couples to resolve conflicts and improve relationships.
online_consultation_desc: Convenient video call counseling service, saving travel time.
target_audience: People with anxiety and depression issues
getting_started_message: You don't need to be an expert to get started — just one simple step to find the right person for you.
team_description: A team of professional psychologists and managers committed to delivering the best user experience.
clinical_director_bio: Clinical psychologist with over 15 years of experience. Leading expert in CBT and EMDR therapy.
head_of_operations_bio: 10 years of experience in technology project management and product development in healthcare.
privacy_features: No sharing of personal information with third parties
Right to complete data deletion upon request
Strict compliance with personal data protection laws
security_measures: Regular security audits by third parties

faq_items.question: How do I know which expert is right for me?
faq_items.answer: You can view detailed profiles, specializations, experience, and reviews of each expert. We also have a recommendation system based on your needs.

faq_items.question: How much does counseling cost?
faq_items.answer: Costs range from 300,000 - 1,200,000 VND per session depending on the service type and expert experience. You can see specific prices on each expert's profile.

faq_items.question: Is my information kept confidential?
faq_items.answer: Absolutely. We apply end-to-end encryption and strictly comply with personal information security regulations.

faq_items.question: Can I cancel appointments?
faq_items.answer: Yes, you can cancel appointments 24 hours in advance without charge. Cancellations within 24 hours may incur fees according to each expert's policy.

faq_items.question: What if I need emergency support?
faq_items.answer: For emergency cases, please call the hotline 113 or contact the nearest medical facility. PsyConnect does not provide emergency psychological services.
